fragments.text: The `getActiveRedeemRequesters()` & `getActiveDepositRequesters()` can be DOSed by creating many small requests
In `ERC7575VaultUpgradeable.sol`, there are two view functions that return active requesters but revert when more than 100 requesters exist:
The `requestRedeem()` function has no minimum amount check (only `shares > 0`):
A malicious user with shares can create many 1-wei redeem requests using different controller addresses, causing `getActiveRedeemRequesters()` to always revert once > 100 unique controllers exist.
